{{Otheruses|Priest}}
A '''priest-scientist''' was a member of the government and religion of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] species. Sometime between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref>The date of [[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']] is not given in the adventure, but it must occur within this range, as the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] has been destroyed and [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] has not yet been assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].</ref> priest-scientists investigated a piece of wreckage from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] and discovered that it contained a powerful [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]]. The priest-scientists tweaked the device and used it to bring order to the Ugors' [[Star system/Legends|system]]-spanning salvage yard, the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]].<ref name="SH ">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
